items.stem: Which TWO behaviours best reflect a leader applying SAFe's Lean-Agile principles? (Select TWO)

options.text: Decentralising appropriate decisions to the teams closest to the work

options.text: Organising around value streams rather than silos
Copying ceremonies without changing the operating model
options.rationale: Ceremony-copying is not applying the principles.

options.text: Funding short-lived projects over value streams
options.rationale: This works against Lean portfolio principles.
